title: Kagamine Rin — Playing Tag With Lion Dance Robot〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Playing Tag With Lion Dance Robot（4★）
meta.Event: Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This year's almost over.
It went by like a flash, huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it did. We were able to put on quite a few shows, and got to see Tsukasa and the others grow as a troupe. A wonderful year all in all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah☆ And we got to see a bunch of really amazing shows from them too♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Miku! Everyone!
Wonderhoy!!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, speaking of which...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Emu! You guys! Welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What brings you all here today?
Are you practicing for a show?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, we came to say hi since the year's about to end.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our plan is to do this again when everybody's gathered, but since you're here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
KAITO, Miku, Rin...
We appreciate everything you've done for us this past year.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you as well. We too enjoyed everything that happened this past year.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's keep doing lots and lots more fun shows next year!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which!
Are you guys gonna do a New Year's show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course! We already have a plan for that and just began practicing for it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?! That's so cool! What's it about?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna know too♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Before we tell you, we need to introduce you to someone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Who?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
C'mon on over! Don't be shy!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP! CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Lion Dance Robot!
Long time no see! How have you been?

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. He's very happy today because it's been so long since he last saw all of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, while I've already had my head chomped on twice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What?! Twice?! Oh, hang on...
You sound happy about that, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, that's because it's a sign of good luck.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: True. It's supposed to absorb all of your bad luck when it bites your head, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. It's also good luck in the sense that the Japanese words “bite” and “god” work as a pun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The same goes for a “sign of good luck” and “great acting”!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Then, Lion Dance Robot chomping on you means you'll become a better actor!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now you're just stretching your luck.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Isn't that the point of these sorts of things? Right, Lion Dance Robot?!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP! CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha. He seems really happy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, he certainly does.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He'll be starring in the New Year's show that we just mentioned, so we'd like you to wish him luck.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
He will?!
So that's why you brought him here today!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP! CHOMP! CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Do you want to play with us?

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP! CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, let's play!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Rui, mind if we play with him?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Not at all, please do.
But I would like to introduce him to Len at some point.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
MEIKO and Luka too.
We still need to thank them for what they did for us this past year.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They should be at the stage right now, so why don't we head over?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I bet Len's gonna love it when he sees you, Lion Dance Robot! After that, let's all play!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP! CHOMP!
